intervals.label: PLUTO data taking (DORIS and PETRA)
intervals.locator: Ziemann (DORIS start); Bethke & Wagner (2022), section 2 (replacement by CELLO in March 1980)
intervals.note: Union of the two phases. PLUTO is recorded as ending in March 1980 when CELLO replaced it at PETRA; whether PLUTO took data elsewhere later (for example back at DORIS) is not stated in the sources fetched.
intervals.quote: Towards the end of 1974, the two detectors PLUTO and DASP were placed in their respective collision points.

intervals.label: PLUTO removed from PETRA; replaced by CELLO
intervals.note: End of PLUTO at PETRA; later activity of the detector, if any, is not sourced here.
intervals.quote: PLUTO had already operated [32] at the precursor storage ring DORIS, and was replaced at PETRA in March 1980 by the newly built CELLO detector [33].

summary.plain: The collaboration that built and ran the PLUTO detector, first at DESY's DORIS ring and then at the PETRA collider.
summary.technical: PLUTO collaboration: DESY-based detector collaboration active at DORIS (from 1974) and PETRA (1978-1980); composition not retrieved.
